verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a detailed REST API reference with request/response payload examples and code samples via CLI/Terraform/SDKs (databricks-docs-65, databricks-supp-api-reference-examples), but the same doc explicitly states 'No live try-it runner is documented,' and probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger endpoint to power an interactive explorer (databricks-probe-2). This gives static, copyable examples rather than a true in-browser runnable API reference. Missing for 10: an in-page 'try it now' execution console, OpenAPI-based interactive explorer, and confirmation of live request execution against a user's workspace from the docs site.
